name: liveql

scripts.//test: The globs are expanded by the shell into file paths: Node 22's test runner treats a bare directory argument as a file to run, and discovering a directory named test would also pick up test/helpers/*.js as test files. test:n4m runs the same suite under the Node binary the device actually uses; the path is the Live 12 Suite one, other Live editions differ. test:live mutates the open Live Set.
scripts.build:dist: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp liveql.amxd liveql-m4l.js liveql-n4m.js package.json pnpm-lock.yaml pnpm-workspace.yaml dist/ && pnpm install --dir dist --prod --config.node-linker=hoisted --ignore-scripts

//engines: Node for Max bundles v22.18.0 -- `"$N4M/source/bin/osx/node/node" --version`, not the Node on your PATH; the Node for Max README claiming v20.6.1 is stale, the binary is what runs.
